thread:
Priya Patel: Quick async standup for roadmap items + launch prep.
Priya Patel: What I did: built routing prototype for multi-variant fallback, added telemetry hooks, pushed draft PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/487
Priya Patel: Blockers: need decision on fallback priority order (cost-first vs latency-first). Also waiting on infra confirmation for canary capacity.
Priya Patel: Today: pair with Alex on perf testing, finish spec doc edits, and unblock QA tests.
Alex Chen: Saw the PR, will review this afternoon. Perf numbers look OK for 512 tokens but we should test longer tails.
Alex Chen: My vote is latency-first for the initial rollout, can revert to cost-first in a later opt-in.
Sam Torres: I can carve out canary GPUs for the test window between 2-4pm PST. @infra-bot can you reserve? :thumbsup:
infra-bot: confirmed: reserved 2x A100 for 14:00-16:00 PST on canary-pool-3. Reservation ID: rb-9921
Samira Kapoor: FYI the end-to-end test keeps failing on kv-cache warmup step. Error: "KV cache mismatch at step 3". I left a failing log snippet in the PR.
Priya Patel: @Samira thanks — I'll repro locally and add a temporary toggle to skip cache warming if needed for canary.
Jason Li: Quick prioritization note from PM side: landing fallback order change now will risk the launch SLAs, could we scope fallback as a post-launch opt? We want minimal behavior changes for first rollout.
Alex Chen: Agreed with Jason. Keep launch behavior conservative. We'll do latency-first and ship simple fallback order.
Priya Patel: Ok sounds good — I'll update the spec to mark advanced fallback as v1.1 work and add a migration plan.
Sam Torres: Once PR is merged can someone trigger the canary deploy? I can monitor QPS and tail latency.
Alex Chen: I'll trigger after my review + green CI. Ping me when tests pass.
Samira Kapoor: Re: tests, I tracked the kv-cache mismatch to a quantization flag. Pushed a small fix — rerunning.
Priya Patel: Great. If CI looks good let's aim to merge by 18:00 UTC and start the canary at 14:00 PST tomorrow.
Jason Li: I'll update the roadmap card to reflect the narrower launch scope and note the v1.1 follow-ups.
Alex Chen: LGTM on plan.
Priya Patel: Thanks everyone — post any blockers here and I'll consolidate for the launch doc. :rocket:
